buckets.name: Plant-Based & Fermentation Proteins
buckets.scope: Animal-protein replacements made from plants or via fermentation (no animal cells)
variations: Precision fermentation of dairy proteins (whey, casein)
Precision fermentation of egg, heme & specialty proteins (collagen, etc.)
B2B plant-protein ingredients, isolates & texturization tech

buckets.name: Cultivated Meat & Novel Protein Sources
buckets.scope: Proteins from cultured animal cells or non-traditional organisms and feedstocks
variations: Cultivation enabling tech (cell lines, growth media, bioreactors, scaffolds)
Insect protein & farming (black soldier fly, mealworm, cricket)
Gas fermentation / single-cell protein (CO2, H2, methane feedstocks)
Molecular farming (animal proteins grown in crops)

buckets.name: Livestock & Rice Methane
buckets.scope: Cutting CH4 from enteric fermentation, manure, and rice paddies
variations: Enteric feed additives — synthetic (3-NOP), oils, tannins, probiotics/enzymes
Manure management, slurry treatment & livestock biogas digesters
Rice paddy methane reduction (alternate wetting/drying, direct seeding, microbials, low-CH4 varieties)

buckets.name: Fertilizer & Crop Inputs
buckets.scope: Cutting N2O and the footprint of synthetic fertilizers and agrochemicals
variations: Green, distributed & on-farm ammonia / nitrogen production (ag-side)

buckets.name: Precision Ag, Robotics & Controlled-Environment Ag
buckets.scope: Tech to grow more with less land, water, energy, and chemical input
variations: Ag robotics & autonomous machinery (weeding, harvesting, tractors)
Satellite / drone remote sensing, imaging & crop analytics
IoT sensors & smart irrigation / water-efficiency tech
Controlled-environment agriculture (vertical farms, greenhouse automation, container farms)

buckets.name: Regenerative Agriculture & Soil Carbon
buckets.scope: Building soil carbon and ecosystem health on working croplands and rangelands
variations: Soil carbon measurement, dMRV & agricultural carbon-credit programs

buckets.name: Food Loss & Waste
buckets.scope: Preventing and valorizing food lost or wasted across the supply chain
variations: Surplus food marketplaces, redistribution & dynamic pricing
Retail / kitchen waste analytics & demand forecasting (inventory AI)
Post-harvest loss reduction & off-grid cold chain / storage
Anaerobic digestion & composting of food / organic waste

buckets.name: Forests & Deforestation-Free Supply Chains
buckets.scope: Protecting, restoring, and monitoring terrestrial carbon-rich ecosystems and supply chains
variations: Reforestation / afforestation tech (drone seeding, seed & nursery tech, native species)
Restoration project developers & forest carbon project origination
Forest / biomass carbon MRV (satellite, lidar, AI)
Forest carbon credit ratings, registries & marketplaces

buckets.name: Blue Carbon & Coastal Ecosystems
buckets.scope: Coastal and marine carbon sinks plus low-impact ocean food and biomass
variations: Coastal / blue carbon MRV & credit methodologies
